body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung and eidicom together presented ''EW-700'' WiFi Smart phone that embraces Post-PC mobile multimedia processor that they developed. This VoIP Smart phone is a feature-rich device that offers web browser, messenger, mp3p, movie player, USB storage, IR communication, 2M camera, camcorder, camcorder, recorder, Outlook data sync.
